subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields`/`providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates a new provider config contract and repository policy treats new config/default surfaces and provider routing as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without adding generic core config.

options.title: Add only typed beta config
options.body: Support a narrow Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding arbitrary Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before OpenClaw sends it.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without adding generic core config.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider/plugin ownership and config-contract policy, and steipete is the strongest history signal for those boundaries.
